async function build(items, callbacks) {
	for (
		let i = 0, n = items.length;
		i < n;
		i++, callbacks.push(async () => await save(i))
	) {}
	for (; hasCallback(async () => await save(1)); ) {
		consume();
	}
	for (
		let i = 0, n = items.length;
		i < n;
		i++,
			callbacks.push(async function () {
				await save(i);
			})
	) {}
}
